summary: Implemented bounded search-index lock contention retry for refresh/rebuild, added shared runtime lock inspection for doctor and lock inspect, and made stale-lock detection use same-host owner PID plus heartbeat instead of only a fixed stale window.
command: COREPACK_HOME=/private/tmp/corepack pnpm check; git diff --check; COREPACK_HOME=/private/tmp/corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/file-store.test.ts tests/runtime/cli.test.ts --testNamePattern 'same-host dead-owner|runtime lock state|search-index lock|transient search-index lock contention|stale runtime locks|stale generated search index locks'
